global.responseRule: 2xx → read solved; non-2xx → read detail. Never both.

envVars.name: BROWSER_HEADLESS
envVars.description: 0 = headed for all browser solvers (use Xvfb on servers)

envVars.name: TURNSTILE_GEOIP
envVars.description: 1 = align tz/locale/WebGL to proxy IP (Turnstile, Cloudflare, AWS WAF)

envVars.name: SOLVER_ALLOW_PRIVATE
envVars.description: 1 = allow private/loopback URLs (SSRF guard off — dev only)

envVars.name: SOLVER_PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Public base URL in OpenAPI docs

mistralSetup.title: Mistral vision (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Aliyun VLM)
steps: Add Mistral API keys in the form below (one per line) or edit common/apikey.txt
Set vision models below (saved to common/mistral.json)
Default model: mistral-medium-latest (pixtral-12b aliases to a text-only model on this API)

solvers.name: Cloudflare Turnstile
solvers.summary: Mint a Turnstile response token for any sitekey.

modes.name: Route intercept (default)
modes.description: Fastest. Intercepts target URL, serves local widget page. Some sites reject stub tokens.

modes.name: Route + verify
modes.description: Solve then POST verify_url from same session. Use verify_payload with __TOKEN__ placeholder.

modes.name: Real page
modes.description: Set real_page: true. Navigate live site, run pre_actions, click checkbox, optional post_fetch.

optional.description: click | fill | wait | select | press before widget

tips: If token is rejected (invalid-input-response), switch to real_page: true
Use residential proxy on hard targets
pre_actions support CSS, XPath (//), text=, regex=, role= selectors

solvers.name: Google reCAPTCHA
solvers.summary: v2 checkbox, v3 score, invisible, and Enterprise variants.
solvers.returns: token, score (v3 with secret), method, elapsed

modes.name: v3 (default action: submit)
modes.description: grecaptcha.execute() — no interaction, ~4s. Best for score keys.

modes.name: invisible
modes.description: Same as v3 for invisible sitekeys. Use real_page for hard origins.

modes.name: v2 checkbox
modes.description: Clicks checkbox; image grid solved via ONNX hybrid or Mistral.

modes.name: Enterprise
modes.description: Add enterprise: true — loads enterprise.js

optional.description: Site secret to also return v3 score via siteverify
auto | hybrid | yolo | mistral — tile classifier for image challenges
Navigate live page (needed when enterprise.js 403s on stub)

tips: v3 from residential IP can score 0.9 without proxy
classifier: hybrid uses local ONNX first, Mistral for unknown targets
Audio challenge path removed — use v3/invisible or image classifier
Place Mistral keys in common/apikey.txt for image challenges

solvers.name: hCaptcha
solvers.summary: Checkbox, invisible execute, and real-page solving with vision fallback.

modes.name: Checkbox (default)
modes.description: Route-intercept widget + checkbox click + Mistral image grid

modes.name: Invisible
modes.description: Set action: "invisible" — hcaptcha.execute(), zero interaction

modes.name: Real page
modes.description: real_page: true with pre_actions and post_fetch

tips: Test key 10000000-ffff-ffff-ffff-000000000001 always passes (no challenge)
Image grids use numbered-cell Mistral classification (one call per page)
hCaptcha triggers challenges more aggressively than Turnstile — use proxy + headed mode
Requires common/apikey.txt for image challenges

solvers.name: Cloudflare Clearance
solvers.summary: Pass full-page interstitial and harvest cf_clearance cookie.
solvers.returns: cf_clearance, cookies, user_agent, headers (no top-level token)

modes.name: Managed Challenge
modes.description: Turnstile checkbox in iframe — needs headed browser

modes.name: JS Challenge
modes.description: Checking your browser… — auto-resolves

optional.description: Strongly recommended — cookie bound to exit IP

tips: Replay: same proxy IP + exact user_agent + matching TLS (curl-impersonate or CloakBrowser)
Datacenter IPs often fail — use residential/mobile proxy
cf_clearance TTL ~15–30 min — re-solve on expiry
Do NOT use Turnstile stub for Managed Challenge — token gets code 1201

solvers.name: AWS WAF
solvers.summary: Silent JS proof-of-work challenge → aws-waf-token cookie.

modes.name: Silent challenge
modes.description: Background token.js runs invisibly — supported

modes.name: Visual puzzle
modes.description: NOT supported — will timeout if escalated

tips: Same replay contract as Cloudflare: IP + JA3 + User-Agent
CloudFront hard-blocks detected early — use residential proxy
Interactive visual puzzle not implemented

solvers.name: Google BotGuard
solvers.summary: Extract bgRequest token from Google OAuth sign-in flow.
solvers.returns: token, cookies, cookie_header, replay_url, replay_body, user_agent

modes.name: Account lookup (MI613e)
modes.description: email only — soft-signal token

modes.name: Password gate (B4hajb)
modes.description: email + password — hard-gate token

required.value: Google account email to enter in sign-in flow

optional.description: Drives to password RPC for B4hajb token

tips: Token cannot be generated offline — browser run required once
Replay via curl_cffi with returned cookie_header + replay_url
Token is per-session — not reusable across accounts
~30–40 seconds per extraction

solvers.name: DataDome
solvers.summary: Harvest datadome clearance cookie via silent tags.js pass.

modes.name: Silent pass
modes.description: tags.js POSTs jspl → api-js.datadome.co/js/ returns cookie

modes.name: Interactive captcha
modes.description: Returns error if captcha-delivery URL — not yet supported

optional.description: Framing referer for correct DataDome config
Harvest and replay from same IP

tips: Site-agnostic — caller supplies url + referer for each deployment
GitHub signup: octocaptcha URL + referer https://github.com/
Cookie is IP + UA bound — replay with same proxy and user_agent
Form scraping (CSRF, honeypot) is caller's job

solvers.name: PerimeterX / HUMAN
solvers.summary: Press & Hold gate → _px3 clearance cookie via CDP mouse hold.

modes.name: outlook_signup (default)
modes.description: Walks throwaway Outlook signup form to surface gate

modes.name: Direct URL
modes.description: render_flow: null + url when gate renders on load

optional.description: Target when gate renders on plain load

tips: Replay full cookie bundle (_px3 + _pxvid + _pxde + pxcts)
Gate is intermittent — solved:false + gate_reached:false is honest failure
Short TTL — replay within minutes from same proxy + UA
Add new sites via perimeterx/renderers/

solvers.name: Akamai Bot Manager
solvers.summary: Harvest validated _abck cookie via bmak telemetry sensor.

modes.name: bmak telemetry
modes.description: Load page → sensor boots → real input → poll until _abck validated

optional.description: Gated resource fetch may need post_fetch

tips: Validated _abck drops ~-1~-1~-1~ sentinel — heuristic only, verify with real replay
Bound to IP + JA3 + User-Agent
Slow proxies may need longer timeout or cleaner residential IP
Browser mandatory — sensor embeds server nonce from bm_sz cookie

solvers.name: Aliyun Captcha 2.0
solvers.summary: Slide-puzzle solver with YOLO gap detection + humanized drag.

modes.name: Self-hosted widget
modes.description: Renders SDK on minimal local page — never visits target site

optional.description: Verify from same IP if used

tips: No sitekey or url — identity is scene_id + prefix from target page config
Requires onnxruntime + opencv-python-headless; best.onnx for YOLO gap detect
Token is one-time — replay immediately into VerifyCaptchaV3
T001 = pass, F001 = behavioral fail, F015 = wrong position
Drag uses overshoot-and-correct kinematics (not just position)

solvers.name: Arkose FunCaptcha
solvers.summary: Visual puzzle solver via ONNX classification + multi-wave pipeline.

modes.name: Multi-wave
modes.description: Intercept gfct → predict → AES encrypt → POST /fc/ca/ up to max_waves

optional.description: Arkose service URL override (auto-detected from gfct)

tips: 24 ONNX models in arkose/models/ (~1.4GB) — unknown variants fail
Full solve ~45–60s for 7 waves
Requires onnxruntime for inference
Answers encrypted AES-CBC with session_token from gfct
